rule.load: smallest input-pin capacitance of a cell synthesis may instantiate (one sink, no wire); PDK-excluded, owner-reserved and output-less cells are not sinks; raised to a table's smallest load index where that is larger
rule.member: worst over every output pin, timing arc and rise/fall transition table (three_state_disable skipped), bilinear, no extrapolation
rule.family: DRV-limited when even its best member exceeds max_transition_ns
rule.source: owner decision 2026-10-24 (GF180 DRV / cell policy); SDC set_max_transition 1.0 unchanged
